en-US: Trackhop 2.2.7. YouTube Music with your own key is much quicker: Google's Personal mode makes the key in one page and no longer signs you out every 7 days. On Jellyfin, Navidrome and other servers, songs whose titles start with a track number are now found, and missing songs are searched again after a library rescan. Clearer messages, and a crash during Google sign-in is fixed.
